instruction: Download the last Tuesday's weekly work meeting slides and recording from Gmail and save them in my file system as per the existing file structure and format.
notes: Current date 2023-05-19 (Friday) so last Tuesday is 2023-05-16. The agent must log in to both file_system (its token is required by gmail.download_attachment and to inspect the existing directory layout) and gmail. file_system.show_directory (recursive) yields (structure-known), which is a precondition of every download so the destination paths follow the existing structure/format. gmail.show_inbox_threads with a query discovers the meeting thread id; gmail.show_thread exposes the attachment ids (static attached-to facts). Each gmail.download_attachment with download_to_file_path produces (downloaded ?attachment ?path); the goal requires both the slides and the recording to be saved and no other file changes. The two attachment and path objects are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task (no answer parameter) can require both downloads as its precondition.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'username', 'password', 'person', 'query', 'email-thread', 'flag', 'dir-path', 'app', 'attachment', 'token', 'file-path'}
